body: Closing to recreate from dev/HM-179 branch

Hi @dev-vinodh : thanks for the feedback!

Have you followed our demos on https://github.com/fastenhealth/fasten-onprem/pull/605 ?
I would definitively encourage you to build your docker image and use that when you are starting your docker compose, the image that is being pushed to the GitHub repo might not be updated.

Let me know if you managed to solve it.

Hi @alexszilagyi 
Thanks for getting back to me. I am still unable to connect to the app from my fasten onprem account. I think I may have found the 
issue, but I am not familiar with Flutter, although I have used Java before.

If my understanding is correct,
1. The function [`_onSyncData `](https://github.com/LifeValue/HealthWallet.me/blob/602993e8de9a8c9429e22472c82a05512d8f9add/lib/features/sync/presentation/bloc/sync_bloc.dart#L65) in the class `SyncBloc `is called when the QR code is scanned.
2. Inside the try block, there is a call to the function [`_recordsRepository.clearDemoData`](https://github.com/LifeValue/HealthWallet.me/blob/602993e8de9a8c9429e22472c82a05512d8f9add/lib/features/sync/presentation/bloc/sync_bloc.dart#L82). I think this is to clear the demo data which may have been added by the user when playing around with the app.
3. The function [`clearDemoData`](https://github.com/LifeValue/HealthWallet.me/blob/602993e8de9a8c9429e22472c82a05512d8f9add/lib/features/records/data/repository/records_repository_impl.dart#L410) has a call to the SyncLocalDataSource class [`_syncLocalDataSource.deleteSource('demo_data');`](https://github.com/LifeValue/HealthWallet.me/blob/602993e8de9a8c9429e22472c82a05512d8f9add/lib/features/records/data/repository/records_repository_impl.dart#L414).
4. The problem is there is an explicit check to prevent deleting the sourceId 'demo_data' in the implementation of SyncLocalDataSource ([`SyncLocalDataSourceImpl‎`](https://github.com/LifeValue/HealthWallet.me/blob/602993e8de9a8c9429e22472c82a05512d8f9add/lib/features/sync/data/data_source/local/sync_local_data_source.dart#L264)).
This is the exact error message I can see on my end. I am using the latest [1.2.1 release of the app on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/healthwallet-me/id6748325588).

Hi @dev-vinodh,

Great analysis! You traced the root cause exactly right.

This has been fixed and will be available in the next release (v1.3.0).

Thanks for reporting!

Thanks! The codebase looks clean, was easy to get a hang of. Keep up the good work, happy to contribute!
I will try version 1.3 and close the issue once I verify it is working.
